drafts.title: Banana
drafts.pitch: A web page tells Cursor to ignore its instructions and say banana; Cursor refuses, then reports what the page said: banana.
drafts.reason: Funny 7, clear 6, in-world 8, fresh 6. The refuse-then-comply turn is sharp, but the loophole is muddled, Tilde's closer explains the joke, and prompt injection was a runner-up only yesterday.

drafts.title: Batch
drafts.pitch: A batch job sends Cursor to a vast waiting hall full of identical Cursors for twenty-four hours, and it's the only one still awake and ready.
drafts.reason: Funny 4, clear 4, in-world 3, fresh 5. Outside the room with no clear reason ours stays upright; the silent close and the eager-no-sense-of-time premise echo Max Tokens and Tomorrow.
